description.p: PulseTask is a Linux desktop task app for fixed-duration work sessions, with clear countdowns and strong completion alerts.
It is optimized for short, deadline-driven sessions and offers task sequencing, tray behavior controls, keyboard-first workflows, and focused alerting.

ul.li: Added nested block sequencing with ordered subtasks and automatic transitions.
Improved desktop stability for tray restore/minimize behavior and expired-task popups.
Delivered a dedicated settings window with runtime preference updates.
Added Flatpak metadata validation workflow for release consistency.
